brief: Prioritise pre-event attention for Briarcliff Bluff 230/34kV due to its advanced age and thermal exposure risks [MG-023]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. If a vegetation or obstruction defect is outstanding, clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity to maintain the unit's cooling margin [SOP-011].
